description: Skill for invoking import or update of the production database as Stage 6 infrastructure (operating system). Treats DB maintenance as a first-class "agent slot" task: spec-driven, heavily cache-backed, followed by .github/skills/eval/maintenance-task/SKILL.md, with observability. Maximizes shared context (docs/codebase, TODO, previous evals, architecture, mysql expert) to avoid "ten things" and ensure clean prod state. Use for full clean import from latest local backup (for dirty prod reset) or updates (e.g. via daily listings job + verification). Always run from host (not ddev exec for doctl/mysql to prod). Sources .env for DO_APP_ID, TARGET_*, etc.
